rationale: Dependency caching is already provided by ruby/setup-ruby with bundler-cache: true, so the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE optimization is satisfied and adding a separate actions/cache would be redundant (its contraindication: an equivalent cache already exists). No matrix, schedule, or multi-job test set exists, so fail-fast, schedule suppression, test selection/prioritization, and build-selection patterns do not apply. The supported P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern fits: representative successful-duration history exists (five recent successful runs, all well under a minute), and adding an explicit job timeout bounds runaway consumption without changing coverage, permissions, secrets, or network access. A 30-minute budget gives ample operational headroom over the observed sub-minute runs while capping any hung job.
